annotations.title: Verify a batch of AI agent artifacts

description: Verify several artifacts at once — a scan report, a list of findings, a set of tool descriptions. One call, one verdict per artifact, plus a summary of how many were accepted, need review, or were rejected. Use when an agent produced a batch (twenty findings from a security scan, for example) and each of them has to be checked before the work is paid for.

artifacts.description: The artifacts to verify: objects, arrays or strings.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema every artifact must satisfy.

source.description: Where the artifacts came from, recorded in the attestations.
